assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production battlefield terrain texture atlas for a Han-era top-down strategy game.
Primary request: Create exactly a 2:1 landscape image, 2048 x 1024 pixels. The entire canvas is an exact regular grid of four columns and two rows, containing eight equal square fields of 512 x 512 pixels each. Every field reaches all four edges of its square. No spacing, borders, frames or outlines between fields.
Grid order, left to right:
Top row, column 1: clean bright jade and olive grassland; broad smooth organic color patches.
Top row, column 2: stylized emerald forest tree canopies seen straight from above; rounded attractive clean overlapping canopy masses, clearly a forest.
Top row, column 3: smooth pale green rolling hills; broad gently shaded landform bands with a readable hills material.
Top row, column 4: clean blue-grey sculpted rocky mountain ridges seen straight from above; strong large angular ridge forms, restrained smooth shading.
Bottom row, column 1: calm clear azure water with broad gentle ripples, clean open water filling every edge.
Bottom row, column 2: clean grass field with one small traditional Han Chinese fort placed precisely at the square's centre; fort occupies about one quarter of the field width, leaving broad seamless grass around it.
Bottom row, column 3: clean grass field with one small traditional Chinese walled city or capital placed precisely at the square's centre; compact walls and palace rooftops occupying about one third of the field width, leaving broad seamless grass around it.
Bottom row, column 4: clean golden dry grass; broad smooth organic patches.
Style/medium: top-down orthographic strategy-game illustrations, soft clean shapes, deliberate restrained detail, attractive vibrant readable material differences. Each tile must read at small game scale.
Materials/textures: broad smooth painterly material fields with low frequency detail only. Terrain reaches edges naturally and is suitable for bitmask autoblending. Grass backgrounds of the fort and capital exactly match the jade/olive grassland tile palette and surface treatment.
Lighting/mood: uniform flat soft daylight across all eight tiles; gentle broad shading; no dark vignette.
Constraints: The eight fields MUST be equal squares in an exact 4-by-2 arrangement on a 2:1 canvas. No gutters, margin or border. No hex outlines. No labels, text, numbers, UI, troops or isolated showcase objects. No floating islands. No blank backgrounds. Fort and city remain small and centred.
Avoid: speckles, grain, gritty/dirty/grunge surface, noise, high-frequency microtexture, dark corners, decorative frames, strong cast shadows.

Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: production victory screen background for a Han-era strategy game.
Primary request: Create exactly a 16:9 landscape illustration, 2048 x 1152 pixels, of victorious Han-era army formations celebrating at sunrise before a captured Chinese city.
Scene/backdrop: a traditional Chinese walled city with gate towers and Han-era tiled rooftops stretches across the middle distance; a glowing sunrise shines above it.
Subject: many soldiers in disciplined formations across the lower foreground and lower sides, with Han-era clothing and armour, red banners and celebratory raised spears. This is the collective triumph of an army, not an individual hero portrait.
Style/medium: clean appealing illustrated game art with strong shapes, rich yet restrained colour, soft polished rendering and readable silhouettes. No grit or photographic texture.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 wide composition. Army formations occupy the lower half, framing the city. Keep the central upper portion of the picture broad, open, uncluttered sunrise sky so a large Victory user-interface title can be placed there later. The sky should remain visually calm and highly readable; do not render any UI or text.
Lighting/mood: warm hopeful sunrise, triumphant celebratory atmosphere, soft gold light, appealing red banners, subtle depth through clean shape layering.
Constraints: historical Han-era setting, many soldiers in formations, red banners, raised spears, captured Chinese city, open central upper sky.
Avoid: text, letters, labels, symbols resembling typography, UI, logos, modern elements, firearms, gore, blood, isolated heroic close-up, gritty noise, high-frequency texture.
